response.sql: WITH budget_line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_total FROM budget_line_totals), above_average AS (SELECT blt.total_cost, blt.expense_count, blt.total_cost - at.avg_total as excess FROM budget_line_totals blt CROSS JOIN average_total at WHERE blt.total_cost > at.avg_total) SELECT AVG(total_cost) as average_of_totals, SUM(expense_count) as total_expenses, AVG(excess) as average_excess FROM above_average
